units.text: The claim that Mount Elbert reaches 14,494 feet in the 2001 USGS state elevation table is false. The 2002 USGS data and subsequent surveys list Mount Elbert at 14,440 feet, not 14,494 feet, as recorded in the 2001 table and later updates.
